description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the 'NationalityService' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, mock object creation, and multiple test methods verifying functionalities such as retrieving nationality lists, retrieving by ID, deleting nationalities, and retrieving by name.

classes.name: NationalityServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the NationalityService, including setup and various test methods to verify correct functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including creating a new NationalityService instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of Nationality objects via the service with mocked DAO behavior.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a Nationality by ID via the service with mocked DAO behavior.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple nationalities via the service with mocked DAO behavior.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Nationality by name via the service with mocked DAO behavior.
